godot.entityStructure: One scene per entity (CharacterBody3D root, MeshInstance3D from GLB, Area3D for interaction). Logic in a script that reads stats from the bible JSON.
godot.saves: Save the seed, floor, turn and inventory to user://save.json; the floor is regenerated from the seed.

threejs.entityStructure: Engine-neutral core owns state; the renderer keeps a Map<uid, Object3D> and syncs from state each frame. GLB via GLTFLoader, primitive fallback.
threejs.saves: localStorage key per project: seed, floor, turn and inventory.
